title: Sales Service Manager - Aftermarket & Technical Sales
description:
**Rommelag Engineering India – The perfect place to fulfill your needs**
Would you like to play an active role in ensuring that people worldwide have access to safe medicines?
  
  
Would you like to become part of the
**Rommelag Group**
, with over 2,000 employees and worldwide – the one-stop partner for the aseptic filling of liquid pharmaceuticals?
  
  
**Rommelag Engineering India**
is engaged in manufacturing of spare parts, moulds, and accessories of State-of-the-Art machines (Blow-Fill-Seal machines) being used in pharmaceutical industries for filling I.V. fluids, ear drops, eye drops, etc, all the leading pharmaceutical companies in India and abroad are the prospective customers/users of this machine.
  
  
The BFS machines are manufactured at the holding company’s factories in Rommelag Switzerland and Rommelag Germany.
  
  
**Sounds good? Then apply now in less than 10 minutes – we look forward to hearing from you!**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly driven and technically competent Sales Service Manager to lead our aftermarket business, service sales, and customer development activities.
  
  
**This is not a pure sales role.**
We are specifically looking for a professional who has hands-on experience in both Service and Sales functions within industrial machinery,
**pharmaceutical machinery or packaging machinery industries.**
The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding machine performance issues, identifying technical improvement opportunities, proposing engineering solutions, and converting those opportunities into profitable business through spare parts, machine upgrades, retrofit projects, mould overhauls, service contracts, and new equipment sales.
  
  
**Mandatory Requirements:**

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech Mandatory)
* Minimum 12 years of experience in industrial machinery, pharmaceutical machinery, BFS equipment, packaging machinery.
* Strong experience in BOTH:
* Service Engineering
* Technical Sales / Service Sales / Aftermarket Business
* Proven experience in:
* Spare Parts Business
* Service Contract
* Machine Upgrades & Retrofits
* Customer Technical Discussions
* Aftermarket Sales Growth
* Preferred Industry Background
* Pharmaceutical Machinery
* BFS (Blow Fill Seal) Equipment
* Packaging Machinery
* Process Equipment

**Required Skills:**

* Strong Technical Sales Capability
* Machine Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
* Excellent Customer Handling Skills
* Commercial & Negotiation Skills
* Aftermarket Business Development
* Project Coordination
* Technical Presentation Skills
* Relationship Management
* Independent Business Development Capability

**Candidates without Pharma or Packaging Machinery exposure may not be suitable for this role.**
**Languages:**

* Excellent English Communication
* Hindi Communication (Mandatory)

**Travel Requirement:**
Willingness to travel extensively across assigned territories for customer visits, technical discussions, project reviews, and business development activities.
  
  
**We are specifically looking for someone who can:**

* Understand industrial machines in depth
* Diagnose and discuss machine performance issues confidently
* Suggest upgrades, retrofits, and technical improvements
* Develop strong customer relationships through technical expertise
* Grow spare parts and service revenue consistently
* Convert technical opportunities into profitable business

**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Sales & Business Development

Drive sales growth for spare parts, machine retrofits, upgrades, mould overhauling projects, new mould sales, and service contracts.
  
  
Identify customer pain points related to machine performance, downtime, maintenance, and production efficiency.
  
  
Recommend suitable technical solutions and convince customers on the technical and commercial benefits.
  
  
Develop long-term aftermarket and service business within the assigned territory.
  
  

* Technical Expertise & Customer Support

Strong understanding of BFS machines (preferably), mould systems, mechanical assemblies, pneumatics, hydraulics, and machine wear parts.
  
  
Ability to understand machine problems, analyze failures, and propose technical improvements.
  
  
Read and interpret technical drawings, layouts, spare part catalogs, and service reports.
  
  
Conduct technical discussions confidently with production, maintenance, engineering, and purchase teams.
  
  

* Customer Relationship & Aftermarket Growth

Build strong long-term customer relationships through proactive technical support and regular visits.
  
  
Increase recurring business through spare parts sales, annual maintenance support, machine refurbishment, and upgrade opportunities.
  
  
Support resolution of complaints, technical issues, and overdue matters professionally and efficiently.
  
  

* Internal Coordination & Industry Representation

Work closely with service, engineering, finance, manufacturing, and sales support teams for smooth project execution.
  
  
Support and coordinate with sales/service agents where applicable.
  
  
Represent the company professionally at customer meetings, trade fairs, seminars, and technical events.
  
  
**If you have a combination of strong technical service experience and successful sales/business development experience in Pharma or Packaging machinery, we would like to hear from you.**
**Our Benefits**
**What we offer you:**

* Secure future: A company pension plan and a lifetime working time account give you security for tomorrow.
* Team events: Regular team events and company parties ensure fun and team spirit.
* Top working environment: With employee Wi-Fi, a cool employee app, breakfast and lunch options at Factory location, and much more.

**Have we sparked your interest?**
Then apply now using our online application form.
  
  
At Rommelag, we are on first-name terms across all hierarchical levels—it's part of our corporate culture. We would be delighted if you would also address us by our first names in your application documents.
  
  
Diversity is very important to us at Rommelag! It is important to us that you feel welcome here, regardless of your gender, origin, religion, worldview, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity.
  
  
Looking forward to receiving your application:

title: Head - Sales & Operations
description:
Position title
  
  
Head - Sales & Operations
  
  
**Description**
**Role Overview**
Lead a multi-city field sales and distribution team for a fast-scaling eco-friendly AdBlue (DEF) brand. Own the P&L, client relationships, and the multi-state growth roadmap.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
VBlue manufactures and supplies eco-friendly Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF / AdBlue), built around sustainable, pre-filled packaging designed to improve vehicle SCR performance and reduce plastic waste. This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing, field-sales launch team with clear KRAs, monthly incentives, and a defined growth roadmap.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the P&L and end-to-end delivery of the GTM roadmap, team KRAs, reporting and review matrix, and growth plan for the DEF business across assigned markets.
* Act as the single point of contact for structured weekly and monthly business reporting.
* Drive hiring, onboarding, and structured product and process training for the field team, including TSMs and BDMs.
* Design and sequence territory rollout across assigned geographies.
* Own overall revenue delivery, distributor network expansion, and monthly management scorecards covering revenue, new customer acquisition, retailer onboarding, and collections.
* Lead escalation management, cross-territory strategy calls, and pricing and credit-policy alignment with leadership.
* Track and review team performance against KRAs, including territory revenue, distributor onboarding, and BDM productivity.

**Who You Will Sell To / Work With**

* B2B: Fleet owners, transporters, logistics operators, industrial SCR/genset users, bus operators, OEM and dealer workshops, and construction/mining equipment operators.
* B2C: Individual BS6 diesel car/SUV owners, tractor and farm equipment owners, retail walk-in customers, and genset owners.
* Channel: Regional distributors and stockists across Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 towns, petrol pump and auto-parts networks, and mechanic/service-workshop cooperatives.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 10–15+ years of experience in field sales or channel sales leadership, preferably in lubricants, chemicals, auto-ancillary, industrial B2B/B2C products, or FMCG.
* Proven experience building and leading multi-city sales teams and distributor networks.
* Strong P&L ownership, key account management, and stakeholder/client management skills.
* Data-driven with hands-on experience running KRA/KPI-based performance systems and CRM discipline.
* Willingness to travel across territories.
* Graduate or MBA preferred.
* Automotive, lubricant, or DEF/AdBlue industry exposure is a strong advantage.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Fixed Monthly Salary: ₹50,000 per month.
* Performance Incentive: Industry-best incentive plan.
* Fast-track leadership opportunity in a category-defining, eco-friendly automotive product launch.
* Direct ownership of a high-visibility GTM program with a defined 6-month scorecard.
* Attractive incentive structure tied directly to revenue performance.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month
  
  
**Benefits**

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Chromed Biosciences Pvt. Ltd. is a premier preclinical Contract Research Organization (CRO) focused on turning innovative research into market-ready solutions. From its state-of-the-art facility in Tumkur, the company specializes in medical device biocompatibility, predictive animal disease models, and comprehensive toxicology services. Chromed Biosciences partners with pharmaceutical, biotech, and MedTech organizations to generate scientifically rigorous preclinical data. By integrating advanced cell biology with strong regulatory expertise, the team delivers evidence-based insights that help accelerate global healthcare innovations and improve patient outcomes.

**Role Description**
The Business Development Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Tumkur. This role is responsible for identifying and qualifying new business opportunities in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and MedTech sectors, nurturing relationships with existing and prospective clients, and building a strong sales pipeline for preclinical CRO services. The Business Development Manager will conduct market research, prepare and deliver client presentations, coordinate proposals and quotations, and collaborate with scientific and regulatory teams to align service offerings with client needs. Daily activities include managing outreach campaigns, attending industry events or virtual meetings, tracking performance metrics, and maintaining accurate records in CRM and reporting tools. The role also involves working closely with leadership to develop growth strategies, negotiate contracts, and ensure a high standard of client service and satisfaction.

**Qualifications**

* Strong business development, sales, and account management skills, with experience in building and managing a B2B pipeline.
* Knowledge of preclinical research, CRO services, or life sciences sectors (pharmaceutical, biotech, MedTech) and ability to understand technical offerings.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in market research, competitive analysis, and strategic planning for business growth.
* Experience using CRM tools, MS Office, and basic data analysis for reporting and forecasting.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Business, or related field.
* Demonstrated ability to work on-site in a collaborative, cross-functional environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Prior experience in a CRO - PRE-CLINICAL (Medical Devices, Pharma, or healthcare-related business development role is an advantage).

title: Technical Bid Manager
description:
**About the Business:**




  





 Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.
 



  





**Responsibilities**



* Own end\-to\-end technical bid governance, ensuring bid readiness from RFQ receipt through final submission and management approval.
* Lead RFQ decomposition, requirements analysis, compliance matrix development, and requirements traceability to ensure customer requirements are fully captured and addressed.
* Establish proposal architecture, bid strategy, solution storytelling, and executive\-level presentations to communicate compelling customer solutions.
* Drive go/no\-go decisions, pricing gate reviews, approval milestones, and bid governance reviews, ensuring risks, assumptions, and deviations are visible to decision\-makers.
* Manage proposal review cycles, including Red Team and Gold Team reviews, and ensure timely closure of all review actions.
* Coordinate and prioritize resources across multiple concurrent bid opportunities while maintaining bid quality and submission timelines.
* Review customer RFQs, drawings, specifications, BOMs, standards, and technical data packages to identify gaps, risks, assumptions, and clarification needs.
* Develop structured customer clarification logs and convert incomplete requirements into documented assumptions, dependencies, closure plans, and executable solutions.
* Define solution approaches, basis of estimate, implementation strategies, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Prepare auditable technical evidence, compliance documentation, proposal narratives, management approval packages, and supporting bid artifacts.
* Develop resource plans, cycle\-time estimates, equipment and tooling requirements, NRE, capital expenditure estimates, implementation schedules, and milestone plans.



  





**Qualifications:**



* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, ECE, Industrial or a related engineering discipline. PMP and/or MBA is preferred.



  





**Desired Experience Level:**



* Expertise in RFQ decomposition, bid governance, requirements traceability, compliance management, and proposal development.
* Strong knowledge of technical bid management methodologies, gated review processes, and proposal lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in developing compliance matrices, risk registers, action trackers, requirements traceability registers, and governance documentation.
* Experience creating technical proposals, executive presentations, customer\-facing solution narratives, and management approval packages.
* Strong commercial awareness with the ability to evaluate cost, schedule, risk, contract deliverables, and business impacts.
* Knowledge of manufacturing industrialization, NPI processes, EMS operations, process engineering, quality systems, test strategies, and supply chain considerations.
* Ability to develop resource loading models, cycle\-time calculations, capacity assessments, equipment requirements, tooling estimates, implementation schedules, and capital investment evaluations.
* Experience with ERP, PLM, document management repositories, BOM management systems, and controlled content environments.
* Understanding of change control, configuration management, estimation methodologies, technical documentation, and proposal costing principles.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving capabilities with the ability to make evidence\-based technical and commercial recommendations.
* Proven capability to lead multidisciplinary teams and collaborate effectively across engineering, operations, quality, sourcing, finance, and supplier organizations.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids, work under fixed deadlines, and maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail.

title: Commission Sales Associate
company: SB AIRCON HEAT AND FLOW SOLUTIONS
description:
**Company Description** 
 SB AIRCON HEAT AND FLOW SOLUTIONS specializes in complete air conditioning and ventilation services for the construction industry, including advanced CFD simulations. The company provides end\-to\-end engineering services covering mechanical product development, CAE, CFD and thermal analysis, and design optimization. It also delivers customized HVAC solutions and manufacturing engineering support to meet diverse project requirements. Team members work closely with clients to ensure efficient, reliable, and cost\-effective environmental and mechanical systems for buildings.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Commission Sales Associate role based in Dodda Ballapur. The Commission Sales Associate will identify and pursue new business opportunities for air conditioning, ventilation, HVAC, and engineering services, focusing on construction and industrial clients. Daily responsibilities include generating leads, conducting site visits, presenting solutions, preparing quotations, and following up to close sales. The role involves building long\-term relationships with customers, coordinating with technical teams to align proposals with project requirements, and maintaining accurate sales records. The individual will also monitor market trends, support marketing activities, and contribute to meeting revenue targets through commission\-based sales.

* Strong sales, negotiation, and customer relationship skills, with the ability to identify client needs and present suitable solutions.
* Basic understanding of HVAC systems, air conditioning, ventilation, and engineering services, with willingness to learn technical details.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to interact professionally with contractors, engineers, and project managers.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple inquiries, site visits, and follow\-ups.
* Comfortable working in an on\-site environment in Dodda Ballapur and visiting client locations as needed.

* Proficiency with basic office software (e.g., email, spreadsheets, presentations) for quotations and reporting.
